title: Glossary SKOS concept scheme
description: docs/adr/0020: one skos:Concept per data-model field name recurring across two or more entities. TERM-<hash> ids (a Short hash of the normalized prefLabel). broader/narrower/related are SKOS's own native relationship vocabulary, reserved (empty) until a real hierarchy signal exists; cross_references and derived_from/axtree_ref are pragma's own extensions, since SKOS has no provenance field at all. Structural correctness for pragma's own fields, not the full official SKOS vocabulary.

axtree_ref.description: Reserved: no field-to-AXTree-leaf correlation pass exists yet (the same gap catalog.json's x-region.axtree_ref left reserved, ticket #101).
